name: DiviNationKit Lite
author: Wyarej Ali

sections.description:
DiviNationKit adds 20 creative modules to the Divi Builder. Every module works in Divi 4 and in Divi 5, in the Visual Builder and on the front end.

Upgrading from 1.x? Your layouts keep working. Every module keeps its settings, and when Divi 5 opens a page built with DiviNationKit on Divi 4, it converts each module with all of its settings.

Live preview

Modules

  • Advanced Divider — section dividers with an icon or text in the middle.
  • Alert — info, success, warning and error messages, with an optional close button.
  • Blog Posts — your posts in a grid or list, with categories, meta and pagination.
  • Business Hours — opening hours, one row per day.
  • Dual Button — two buttons side by side, with an optional separator and 2D, border and background hover effects.
  • Fancy Text — headlines with rotating words that slide, fade, zoom, flip or blur in.
  • Flip Card — cards that flip left, right, up or down on hover, with an optional 3D effect.
  • Gradient Heading — headings filled with a linear or radial color gradient.
  • Icon Box — an icon or image with a title, text, badge and button.
  • Icon List — a list where each item has its own icon, badge and tooltip.
  • Logo Slider — a carousel of client or partner logos.
  • Marquee — text or logos scrolling in an endless loop, with an optional separator.
  • Masonry Gallery — an image gallery in a masonry grid, with a lightbox and per-image links.
  • Person — team member cards with a photo, bio and social links.
  • Price List — menu-style price lists with images and descriptions.
  • Progress Bar — skill bars that fill in when they scroll into view.
  • Rating — star ratings with an optional number and text.
  • Review — a customer review with a photo, rating and button, in four layouts.
  • Testimonial Slider — a carousel of customer testimonials.
  • Typing Text — text typed out letter by letter, with a blinking cursor.

Light by design

Each module loads its own CSS and JavaScript, and only on pages that use it. Modules you don’t need can be switched off under DiviNationKit → Modules, which also shows the pages that use each module.

If you have a question or an idea for a module, open a thread in the support forum.

Source code

The JavaScript and CSS in the plugin’s build folder are compiled. Their source and build tools are on GitHub: Unique-Ui/Divinationkit-For-Divi.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip there.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open a page with the Divi Builder, add a module and pick one from the DiviNationKit folder (or type “DiviNationKit” in the module search).

Requirements: the Divi or Extra theme, or the Divi Builder plugin (Divi 4.13 or later, or Divi 5); WordPress 6.0 or later; PHP 7.4 or later.
sections.faq:
Do I need Divi?

Yes. DiviNationKit adds modules to the Divi Builder, so you need the Divi or Extra theme, or the Divi Builder plugin, from Elegant Themes.

Does it work with Divi 5?

Yes. Every module is a native Divi 5 module, with its own settings in the Divi 5 Visual Builder.

Will my Divi 4 pages work after I move to Divi 5?

Yes. When Divi 5 opens a page built with DiviNationKit on Divi 4, it converts each module with all of its settings.

I updated from 1.x. Do I need to change anything?

No. Every module and setting name is the same as in 1.x, so your pages look the same. Version 2.0 also fixes a number of 1.x bugs (see the changelog).

A module shows nothing on a page.

Check that the module is switched on under DiviNationKit → Modules. Switched-off modules show nothing.

Is it free?

Yes.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • New: Alert module: info, success, warning and error messages in three styles, with an optional close button.
  • New: Typing Text, Fancy Text and Marquee modules.
  • New: Divi 5 support. Every module is a native Divi 5 module, and Divi 4 layouts convert to Divi 5 automatically with all their settings.
  • New: DiviNationKit admin page with a dashboard, module switches (with the pages that use each module), settings and help.
  • New: Each module loads its own CSS and JavaScript, only on pages that use it.
  • New: Option to delete the plugin’s data when the plugin is deleted.
  • Fixed: Review showed nothing on PHP 8.
  • Fixed: “Use Button: No” still showed the button in Icon Box and Flip Card.
  • Fixed: Blog Posts ignored “Order By: Title” and printed “Show Content” outside the post.
  • Fixed: Dual Button’s second button took its hover background and corner radius from the first one.
  • Fixed: Font Awesome icons in Person’s social links and Dual Button’s separator.
  • Fixed: Gradient Heading colors on tablet, phone and hover; the radial direction setting.
  • Fixed: Progress Bar “Hide Level Text”, Icon List Item “Use Icon”, Icon Box badge offsets, Logo Slider logo width.
  • Fixed: several custom CSS fields that never matched their element.
  • compatibility: Requires PHP 7.4 and WordPress 6.0.

  • compatibility: WordPress 6.8
